name: [R6] Agent chain: recon tool then another tool under one parent (EQL)
description: Representative single-index correlation (EQL sequence): the same parent process runs a recon tool and then a different offensive tool within a few minutes — the fast, chained behavior of an autonomous agent. True cross-index correlation (R1 egress + R2 container + R7 tooling) is best built with Elastic's rule-on-rule / alert correlation; see this folder's README. Updated 2026-11-08: the Gambit Security report cited below (its own recovered exposed attacker staging server, dated 2026-09-22) is Gambit's own primary account of an incident it discovered, confirmed via multiple independent secondary outlets quoting the same report (gambit.security direct fetch is blocked in this sandbox).
query:
sequence by process.parent.entity_id with maxspan=5m
  [process where event.type == "start" and process.name == "nmap"]
  [process where event.type == "start" and process.name in ("ffuf", "gobuster", "nikto", "sqlmap", "hydra", "nuclei", "wpscan", "msfconsole")]
author: ai-agent-attack-defense
false_positives: Authorized scanning pipelines — allowlist the orchestrator process/host.
